concepts.why: Correctly applies to this command that Average is launched with no words after the class name, so args has no elements; redirected/piped data do not enter args, but no rule or relation is stated beyond the value.

concepts.quote: 1: nothing, the numbers go into data.txt. 2: the average.
concepts.why: Relates `>` to diverting all standard output into the file so nothing appears in the terminal, and `<` to Average reading the file's numbers to produce the average.

concepts.quote: 3: an average of 5 new numbers, no file.
concepts.why: Relates the pipe to the redirect pair: same effect (an average of 5 numbers, fresh ones since RandomSeq runs again) but with no intermediate file created.
